description: Capability for the SOMS two-window shell. Both windows — "main" (the downloaded SPA at somsapp://localhost) and "init" (the bundled bootstrap at tauri://localhost, created on demand for first-run/reconfigure) — get core IPC, desktop notifications, native HTTP to any http/https origin, and ALL app-defined commands (origin/token + shell dynamic-update init_*/handoff/open) via the app-commands "default" aggregate. The http scope is wide because the backend origin is runtime-configured; the webview's native-fetch override (installNativeFetch, web/.../runtime.ts) reaches it through tauri-plugin-http, bypassing the webview CORS gate. Both windows load LOCAL (non-remote) origins — tauri://localhost (bundled) and somsapp://localhost (a registered custom scheme) — so a single capability with no `remote:` block spans them both.
